info.name: Getting in the Way of Alcadno

descriptions.notStarted: #b#p2111008##k, an alchemist from Zenumist, seems to have a plan in store. Now that I'm Zenumist, I should help him out, right? I better go see #p2111008# immediately.
descriptions.inProgress: Zenumist is in conflict with Alcadno... I knew that fact, but I never thought he'd ask me for a favor like this! Anyway, since #p2111008# made the request, I better follow through with it, or I may be in trouble. I'll have to destroy #r200 #o5110300#k that Alcadnos have been working on. \n\n#o5110300#  #r#a33081#
descriptions.completed: I destroyed the #o5110300#s that Alcadnos have been working on, at the request of #p2111008#. Hmmm... was I allowed to do this? Why do Zenumist and Alcadno have such a huge conflict between them?
